verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic SDKs: 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge, including a Cloudflare edge SDK. A community user confirms a mobile client SDK, which together covers backend, client, and mobile breadth. The evidence never explicitly addresses consistent flag behavior across those SDKs, and web SDKs are only implied by the client-side count. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of consistent evaluation semantics across server, web, and mobile SDKs; named first-party web and mobile SDK references; independent hands-on corroboration of cross-stack consistency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior

citations.quote: 30 idiomatic SDKs 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge SDKs.
LaunchDarkly has a mobile client SDK
you can target individuals, segments, or specific mobile apps and devices.
The Cloudflare SDK gets all flags at the edge for a given context, and bootstraps them onto a cached payload
LD clients download all flags in the project on connection, then stream changes.
